entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security context used in EPS for protection of NAS messages between UE and MME. It involves integrity protection and ciphering of EMM and ESM NAS messages.

entities.name: NAS security procedures
entities.description: Procedures used for security protection of EPS NAS messages, including integrity protection and ciphering. These procedures are part of the EMM protocol.

entities.name: EMM NAS messages
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management NAS messages that require security protection through integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: ESM NAS messages
entities.description: EPS Session Management NAS messages that require security protection through integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: Null ciphering algorithm EEA0
entities.description: Ciphering algorithm that provides no encryption. Can be configured in MME to operate network without ciphering.

relations.description: NAS security procedures handle EPS security contexts for protection of NAS messages
EMM NAS messages require security protection through EPS security context
ESM NAS messages require security protection through EPS security context
Null ciphering algorithm EEA0 can be used to operate without ciphering protection
